say:2:1028230001:0.text: Magister, Misarte never gave Randy any gifts or talents... Should we tell him the truth?
say:2:1028230001:0.source_cn: 主人，其实弥萨忒没有赐给兰迪天赋……我们要瞒着他吗？
say:2:1028230001:0.male: Magister, Misarte never gave Randy any gifts or talents... Should we tell him the truth?
say:2:1028230001:0.female: Magister, Misarte never gave Randy any gifts or talents... Should we tell him the truth?

say:3:1028230002:0.text: No, there's no need. Instead of gifts or talents, we gave him something far more important—hope.
say:3:1028230002:0.source_cn: 没关系的。比起天赋，你们给了他更重要的——希望。

say:4:1028230003:1.text: Hope is what you most long for during a journey. It may be far away, but you yearn for it wholeheartedly because, in the end, it's what you want to see the most.
say:4:1028230003:1.source_cn: 希望嘛，是你旅途中最憧憬的地方。可能很远很远，但你一心...

say:5:1028230004:1.text: Let him look into the distance and find the goal to which he aspires, and in getting there, he will naturally discover the longing of his heart.
say:5:1028230004:1.source_cn: 让一个孩子眺望远方，找到自己向往的目标，在前往的过程中...

say:6:1028230005:1.text: That's when he will truly shine.
say:6:1028230005:1.source_cn: 到了那时候，才是天赋真正可以闪光的时刻。

say:7:1028230006:1.text: So we did a good thing then? Chippy feels less guilty now.
say:7:1028230006:1.source_cn: 所以，我们做了件好事吗？哎呀，这下子满满觉得没那么内疚了。

say:11:1028230008:0.text: His gift? You let him grow flowers... Could it be that that's his calling?
say:11:1028230008:0.source_cn: 咦？天赋……你让他种花……难道他的天赋和花有关？

say:12:1028230009:0.text: He never cried for himself, only for the corrupted flowers. With the mere mention of flowers, his eyes would always light up like stars in the sky.
say:12:1028230009:0.source_cn: 他没有为了自己哭泣，却为了那些被污染的花而流泪。一提到...

say:13:1028230010:0.text: You may not know this, but the Jade Lake Academy gives each student a magical seed that grows within them. What blooms will always vary, representing the different directions their futures may take.
say:13:1028230010:0.source_cn: 你们知道吗？翡湖学院会给新生一枚魔法种子，它会伴着学生...

say:14:1028230011:0.text: For Randy... I think his seed will produce the most beautiful flowers Esperia will yet see.
say:14:1028230011:0.source_cn: 兰迪……我想，他的种子一定会开出最漂亮的花朵。
